review.brief_reason: The proposed expression is a purely notational rewrite: every occurrence of '+ (-c)*term' in the original is written as '- c*term' in the proposal, with identical coefficients, variables, operators, and term structure. Under real semantics, a + (-b) = a - b exactly, so the expressions are mathematically equivalent on the same domain (log(x_i+1) requires x_i > -1 in both; all other functions are defined on all reals). No variable renaming, permutation, or operator change occurs. Removing the redundant unary-minus additions is a modest simplification.
